basic_details.job_title: Myladuthurai District Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Mayiladuthurai District is filling the vacant Technical Assistant post for handling digital applications in the Mayiladuthurai District Population Census 2027 work. The post carries a monthly honorarium of Rs.25000/-. Applications from B.Sc (Computer Science), BCA or Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Computer or Technology) holders with qualified prior experience must reach the Urban Livelihood Centre, 4th Floor, District Collectorate, Mayiladuthurai, in person or by registered post by 5.00 PM on 24 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Prepare the application for the Technical Assistant post. The notice prints no application form or format.
Submit it in person or by registered post to: Urban Livelihood Centre, District Mission Management Unit (Mahalir Thittam), 4th Floor, District Collectorate, Mayiladuthurai.
Make sure it is submitted by 5.00 PM on 24 November 2026.
The notice names no documents to enclose.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the age limit, the application fee or the selection process.

content_sections.heading: About Mayiladuthurai District Recruitment
content_sections.text: The notice is a press release of the Mayiladuthurai district administration, signed off in the name of the District Collector, Thiru H.S. Srikanth, I.A.S. The post is to be filled through the Urban Livelihood Centre, which works under the District Mission Management Unit (Mahalir Thittam) at the District Collectorate, Mayiladuthurai. The release carries No. 56 dated 19 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications from persons holding one of the following qualifications and having qualified prior experience. B.Sc (Computer Science) BCA Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Computer) Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Technology) The length and kind of experience required are not specified in the notice. For the full eligibility details, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Technical Assistant will be selected through the Urban Livelihood Centre by the open-market method at a monthly honorarium of Rs.25000/-. The notice does not mention HRA, other allowances or the length of the engagement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Mayiladuthurai District Technical Assistant
content_sections.text: Prepare the application for the Technical Assistant post. The notice prints no application form or format. Submit it in person or by registered post to: Urban Livelihood Centre, District Mission Management Unit (Mahalir Thittam), 4th Floor, District Collectorate, Mayiladuthurai. Make sure it is submitted by 5.00 PM on 24 November 2026. The notice names no documents to enclose.

faq.answer: The last date is 24 November 2026, and the application must be submitted by 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the pay for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The post carries a monthly honorarium of Rs.25000/-.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: B.Sc (Computer Science), BCA, Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Computer) or Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Technology), with qualified prior experience.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the application in person or by registered post to the Urban Livelihood Centre, District Mission Management Unit (Mahalir Thittam), 4th Floor, District Collectorate, Mayiladuthurai.

faq.question: Q5. What work does the Technical Assistant do?

faq.question: Q7. Is prior experience required?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice invites applications from qualified persons who have relevant prior experience; the length of experience is not given.
